title: Gaussian generator pair
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f,g:\bbr^n\to\bbr$. The pair $(f,g)$ has the Gaussian generator property when both functions belong to $L^2$ for the $n$-dimensional product standard Gaussian measure and, as $t\to0$ through positive values, the $L^2$ norm of $\bigl(f-P_{e^{-t}}f\bigr)/t-g$ tends to zero, where $P_{e^{-t}}f$ denotes Gaussian noise with parameter $e^{-t}$ applied to $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ belongs to $L^2$ for product standard Gaussian measure
$g$ belongs to $L^2$ for product standard Gaussian measure
